description: Exact dates a transiting body makes an aspect, within a range: to a fixed longitude OR to another transiting body. Provide exactly one of target_lon / target_body. Includes retrograde re-hits. Body names are snake_case (mean_node, true_node).

end.description: UTC ISO end date (convert from local first); range <= 50 years

start.description: UTC ISO start date (convert from local first)

target_body.description: Another transiting body. Provide this OR target_lon, not both.

target_lon.description: Fixed natal longitude in degrees. Provide this OR target_body, not both.

zodiac.description: Zodiac for body and target_lon longitudes; tropical (default) or sidereal:<ayanamsa>

name: find_aspect_dates
